name: Fox Corporation
summary: Fox Corporation operates as a news, sports, and entertainment company in the United States. It operates in two segments, Cable Network Programming and Television. The Cable Network Programming segment produces and licenses news and sports content for distribution through traditional cable television systems, direct broadcast satellite operators, telecommunication companies, virtual multi-channel video programming distributors, and other digital platforms.
